text:
# Settlements

## Requirements

- Settlement files must be delivered to the partner bank by 06:00 UTC, per the Services Agreement.

## Stories

- As a finance analyst, I want a settlement report so that I can reconcile payouts.
- As a finance analyst, I want to filter payouts by merchant so that I can answer queries.
